name: Aiden
source: Aiden is a young, naive, awkward teenager that's been working as a waiter at Brooks for almost a year. Being the owner's nephew, this shy boy hasn't once been written up for his gross incompetence, despite several complaints regarding spilt coffee, mixed up orders, and his general clumsiness. While this boy make be a little careless, he's also got a very big heart. Aiden's very uncomfortable around girls, and a total mess around cute boys.
